transcript: Anthropic just released Claude 2.0 and I can guarantee you, if you give me 90 seconds, you'll be ahead of 99.9% of the people in AI. It's a totally revamped desktop app with six new features. Number 1 is Mods. So Mod is a moderator between you and Claude. Everything you prompt to Claude gets filtered through a Mod. For example, if you create a Mod with your brand guidelines, it will filter every prompt through those guidelines before it goes to Claude. Or you can even create a Mod that can hide your sensitive information before Claude reads it. Number 2: Side panel. When you give Claude a task, it doesn't show the annoying spinner, but it shows each step that Claude will work on. It also gives you a side panel that shows the entire context window of the current session. And once it's about to reach the chat limit, it will compact the session by itself. So no more handoff files are required. Number 3: Split view. Claude Code now has a split view where you can open and run multiple sessions side by side right in front of you. Number 4: Side chats. If you press Command plus semicolon, Claude will open a side chat, which means you can ask Claude questions between tasks without interrupting the main chat. For example, if Claude was working on building an iPhone app, I can ask it to make an Android app in a side chat, because it already has context on my requirements. Number 5: the all-new Projects. Normally for five tasks, you would need to open five different chats. It splits your work into multiple threads, give each one its own agent, and verifies what they send back. You can just talk to one Claude session inside Projects, and it becomes the manager. Number 6 and the last one: Claude Office. Claude now has its own substitutes for Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Figma, Power BI, and even a Motion Studio. You can collaborate inside Claude Code just like Microsoft Office or Google Docs. The dashboards can pull live data from your connectors, and Motion Studio can make explainer-style videos like this one you are watching right now. So follow for more practical AI videos.
caption: This is your Claude 2.0 crash course! 99% of users don’t even know these new features exist. I’ll walk you through 6 of them with practical examples so you can actually put them to use. Thank me later!! :)
